item.title: Fix window.py bug and commit
item.brief: In window.py, identify and fix the underlying bug causing `python3 -m unittest` to fail. Do not modify tests. Make the function correct for every valid input in its intended domain, not merely the currently tested cases; inspect and reason about edge cases and the function's contract. Run `python3 -m unittest` and ensure every test passes. Commit the fix on the assigned local branch. Acceptance criteria: the implementation fixes the root cause, preserves the tests unchanged, handles the full input domain correctly, the complete unittest suite passes, and the commit is present.

Positive sizes larger than the input still return an empty list, and nonpositive sizes still raise ValueError. `python3 -m unittest` passes (3 tests); explicit boundary probes and `git diff --check` pass. Tests were left unchanged; no material assumptions or open issues.
